## 2026-08-30 read-only refresh

The live permission graph was re-read without secret values or mutations.

GitHub organization 255540067:

- default repository permission remains none; member repository creation is now disabled
- owners: Rickebo (1525411); ordinary member: batmanwarrior (12463054); no outside collaborators observed
- organization 2FA remains disabled
- organization rulesets 14419616 and 14862043 remain disabled; infra/app-config still lack code-owner and last-push review gates
- installation 142598255 remains all-repository with actions, contents, pull requests, and workflows write
- CODICARIUM_AUTOMATION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY metadata still has private-repository-wide visibility
- batmanwarrior has no effective infra/deployment-controller access, but retains write/admin access to app-config and several platform/config repositories through teams

Kubernetes codicarium-dev (explicit kubeconfig/context):

- no repository-, GitHub-, or Authentik-derived group RoleBindings exist
- system:authenticated receives only discovery/self-review/health access; no broad project grant observed
- direct Authentik kube-apiserver OIDC and API audit configuration remain UNKNOWN
- built-in admin/edit roles include token issuance, impersonation, and pod subresource operations and must not be reused for project roles

Argo CD:

- argocd-rbac-cm resourceVersion 34688148 still has policy.default role:readonly and scopes [groups]
- 18 AppProjects expose zero project roles; 99 Applications exist and 70 remain in wildcard default
- explicit admin group mappings remain; real Authentik admin/non-admin claim continuity is still UNKNOWN because no browser is attached

Rancher:

- Generic OIDC is enabled with groups claim and unrestricted accessMode
- rancher-superadmins is the sole observed OIDC group global-admin mapping
- project/cluster bindings are direct-user bindings; no repository-derived group bindings exist
- built-in workloads-view includes pod logs, and workloads-manage includes exec/attach/port-forward, so neither is suitable as the baseline Codicarium viewer/operator role

New operational blocker: deployment-controller PR #159 has all five protected checks green at exact reviewed head 91080852320997f19ff268b65b85fb7f0d0ef5bc but is correctly BLOCKED because the sole CODEOWNER is also author/last pusher. Do not weaken the ruleset; restore a narrow bot-authored PR path or second trusted platform code owner.

Overall authorization isolation remains FAIL. Phase 0 remains gated on real Authentik admin, ordinary-user, and break-glass evidence.
